title: Injective summands with a bijective sum map form an internal direct sum
statement: Let $I$ be a set with decidable equality, let $(N_i)_{i\in I}$ and $M$ be abelian groups, and let $f_i:N_i\to M$ be injective additive homomorphisms. Let $\bigoplus_{i\in I}N_i$ be the group of finitely supported families $(x_i)_i$ with $x_i\in N_i$ (the coproduct of the $N_i$ in abelian groups [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]), and assume the additive map $\bigoplus_iN_i\to M$, $(x_i)_i\mapsto\sum_if_i(x_i)$, is bijective. Then $M$ is the internal direct sum of the subgroups $f_i(N_i)$: the map $\bigoplus_if_i(N_i)\to M$, $(y_i)_i\mapsto\sum_iy_i$, is bijective; equivalently every $m\in M$ is uniquely a finite sum $\sum_iy_i$ with $y_i\in f_i(N_i)$. In Lean: $\mathrm{DirectSum.IsInternal}(i\mapsto\mathrm{AddMonoidHom.range}(f_i))$.
